errors.message: That supplier name is already used
errors.description: Two suppliers of the same clinic cannot share a name.

errors.message: This supplier still has open orders
errors.description: Archiving a supplier with goods still on the way would hide orders the clinic is waiting for.

errors.message: Only a draft order can be changed
errors.description: Once an order is sent its lines are what the supplier was told; correct it by cancelling and writing a new one.
Goods can only be received against an order that was sent and is not already complete or cancelled.
A received or cancelled order cannot be sent, cancelled or received again.

errors.message: More was received than was ordered
errors.description: A receipt cannot exceed what is still pending on the line. Record the surplus as a separate stock movement.

errors.message: Name the lot for this article
errors.description: An article that tracks lots requires a lot code on every receipt, so expiry stays answerable.

errors.description: An order line must point at an article of this clinic's inventory.
